dataset: Multi-Fruit Leaf Image Dataset: Guava, Jackfruit, Mango, and Olive
download_strategy: HTTP range extraction of original-only inner archive; augmented archive not downloaded
notes: Only original images were downloaded; all 18,000 augmented images excluded.
Original images are captured in Bangladesh; labels include condition and growth-stage categories, not only confirmed diseases.
The outer CSV contains class totals only, not per-image collection locations, despite the description's metadata claim.
